SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as trips,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  ROUND(CAST(SUM(yt) AS FLOAT) / (SUM(anglers) + COUNT(*)), 3) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 2 AND fish_date_doy >= 271
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC, yt_per_angler DESC

SELECT 
  ts_doy,
  ROUND(AVG(wtmp_c), 1) as avg_temp_c
FROM pier
WHERE ts_season = 2 AND ts_doy >= 271
GROUP BY ts_doy
ORDER BY ts_doy DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
  report_date_doy,
  yt_local_catch,
  yt_local_sight,
  yt_local_neg,
  text
FROM fishdope
WHERE report_date_season = 2 AND report_date_doy >= 271
ORDER BY report_date_doy DESC
LIMIT 10
